recognize_zh: 單顆大淋巴球有豐富淡藍色細胞質，內含數顆清楚的粗大嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核圓、染色質成熟，是教科書式的大顆粒淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocyte with low N:C ratio
Round to oval nucleus with mature, condensed chromatin; no nucleoli
Abundant pale to clear cytoplasm with a faintly basophilic rim
Several discrete coarse azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Background normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with an oval nucleus containing mature, condensed chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm containing scattered coarse azurophilic granules. Nucleoli are not seen. Surrounding red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; when these cells are persistently increased and clonal, the picture supports T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate them; clonal TCR rearrangement, STAT3 mutation and persistence favor T-LGL leukemia.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia cells are often more atypical with open chromatin and nucleoli, the patient is acutely ill and EBER is positive.
Myeloid cells have folded or lacy nuclei and more numerous fine granules, whereas an LGL has a round condensed lymphocyte nucleus with few coarse granules.
